facts.fact: The data protection authority (APD) issued deliberation 005/2025 on 30 July 2025, requiring public and private data controllers that use cloud services located abroad to obtain prior APD authorisation and to include set clauses (compliance with law 2017-020, foreign-transfer clause, data retrieval and permanent deletion) in the provider contract.
facts.system: Deliberation 005/2025 on minimum conditions for using cloud services abroad
